definitions.gloss: term of endearment; pet name; affectionate nickname
definitions.explanation: A word or name form used to express affection or familiarity, such as shortened names, diminutives, or special nicknames. A linguistic term that also appears in everyday discussions about how people address loved ones.

examples.japanese: 「ゆうちゃん」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愛称語|あいしょうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: 'Yuu-chan' is one type of pet name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛称語|あいしょうご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧「ちゃん」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japanese pet names are often formed by shortening a name and adding '-chan.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{言語学|げんごがく}→言語学：22422_gengogaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{各言語|かくげんご}⟦における→〜における：21802_niokeru⟧{愛称語|あいしょうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: In a linguistics class, I learned about the differences in how pet names are formed across various languages.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧ (pet name; nickname) and ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word; language). While ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧ alone refers to the nickname itself, {愛称語|あいしょうご} treats it as a category of words — a linguistic concept.

JAPANESE PET NAME PATTERNS:
In Japanese, common ways to form {愛称語|あいしょうご} include:
- Shortening + ちゃん: {裕子|ゆうこ} → ゆうちゃん
- Shortening + ⟦くん→くれる：00724_kureru⟧: {太郎|たろう} → たろ⟦くん→くれる：00724_kureru⟧
- Doubling: {真|ま}{美|み} → まみまみ
- っち suffix: さとし → さっち

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛称語|あいしょうご}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call by a pet name
- {愛称語|あいしょうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: how to use pet names

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧: pet name; nickname — the name itself, not the linguistic category
- ⟦ニックネーム→ニックネーム：23549_nikkuneemu⟧: nickname — loanword, broader usage
- ⟦あだ{名|な}→あだ名：10211_adana⟧: nickname — can be teasing or unflattering, unlike ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧ which is always affectionate
